pr_title: Resize BeatmapCarousel and confine its PositionalInput
pr_body:
* Fixes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/5452
* [x] Depends on https://github.com/ppy/osu-framework/pull/2694

Also makes `FilterControl` not block input (similar to the footer).
pr_comments: I've applied the suggestions, but I'm going to try and find out if I can clean up the fade/positioning logic a bit more.

I've combined the new bleed calculations into properties to make them read better, and in the process discovered/fixed some issues. Not sure if this is much better than before though.

Also worth noting that on current master (and now on this branch), individual `DrawableCarouselItems` never become not `IsPresent` since their alpha never actually hits 0. They do, however, get removed from the container and stop being drawn.

Not sure if its worth trying to consolidate more of the logic so that either we remove the checks for presence, or by trying to change the item removal logic to use `IsPresent` instead.

issue_context.title: Beatmap carousel is clickable through the footer
issue_context.body:
This is purposely regressed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/5440. 

It should not block positional input. Instead, the carousel should be contained within the area above the footer, and be unmasked by the footer to provide visibility.
comments:
So I have an implementation ready for this, which involved confining the Carousel area above the footer and below the filter area. This meant I had to update the fading/item removal logic inside `BeatmapCarousel`. 

While I succeeded in updating the logic such that it matches the existing implementation, it now relies on the parent container's sizing and padding, which is kind of ugly. It needs the parent container's sizing (as well as upper and lower padding) to calculate its fade factor and whether or not its on screen.

I can try to do a refactor pass to remove this requirement, or I can pass down the upper and lower padding from `SongSelect` to make this more sane.
